classes.file_summary: DevicesMFE is a page object class for HP Experience (HPX) web application's devices micro-frontend. It extends HPXFlow base class and provides automation capabilities for device management features. The class uses Selenium WebDriver for browser automation and includes support for screenshot comparison testing through SAF decorators. It's designed to handle printer device interactions within the HPX web interface.
test_automation_patterns: Page Object Model (POM) pattern with inheritance from HPXFlow
Selenium WebDriver integration for web UI automation
Screenshot comparison capability via SAF decorator
Device-specific flow management with optional printer parameter
Modular flow architecture with named flow identifier
